threads.body: This file includes a note that when updating this dependency, `dependencyManagement/build.gradle.kts` should be updated as well. Since this PR changes the version here, it should also update the corresponding version in `dependencyManagement/build.gradle.kts` (or centralize the version in a single place such as a version catalog / dependency constraints) to prevent version drift between build logic components.

replies.body: That comment applies to `net.bytebuddy:byte-buddy-gradle-plugin` on the line directly below it, not to `scan-gradle-plugin`. `dependencyManagement/build.gradle.kts` only pins the byte-buddy plugin version; `org.sonatype.gradle.plugins:scan-gradle-plugin` isn't referenced anywhere else in the repo, so there's no version drift here.
